summary: Built the responsive three-column Kanban UI with safe task rendering and complete create, edit, move, and delete interactions against the documented API.

messages.content: Frontend implementation is complete in static/index.html, static/app.js, and static/styles.css. JavaScript syntax and whitespace checks pass; browser end-to-end verification remains dependent on installing Flask.

The UI is ready for acceptance testing: create from the top form, move via each card's status select, edit in the dialog, and delete with confirmation. Validate empty columns, server validation messages, and API-error recovery.

Frontend creates all task text with textContent (not innerHTML), including titles, descriptions, status options, notices, and controls. Please verify this and the API error display in the final review.

blockers: End-to-end browser testing could not run because the local environment lacks Flask and network access prevented installing it; JavaScript syntax validation passed.
